COUNTDOWN: 6 wks — map objectives + weak topics; 4 wks — timed past Qs + canvas answers;
2 wks — cards (acronyms, scripts, 25 points); 1 wk — mock + role-play + sleep; eve — pack
+ rest; DAY — read twice, canvas-structure, cite modules, attempt ALL.
FORMULA: phase → attend → explore → storm → adapt → close. OSCE: think ALOUD. Interviews:
STAR from practice log ("our complaints fell..."); "angry relative?" = LEAP aloud; "why
PORTFOLIO CROWN: practice log + reflections + SBI records + complaint learning + CPD +
role-play videos (consented!). Skills logged = skills owned.
PLEDGE: "I will sit, listen at level 4, ask open, mirror kindly, storm by protocol, adapt
to everyone, close every talk — words that heal, presence that stays."
ELIMINATION TRICK: strike reassurance/advice/judgment/defending — pick empathy + explore.
MANTRA: "phase it, attend it, explore it, storm it, adapt it, close it."
